This named a handful of paths against a directory of dozens, so every backfill, purge-team, reset-sandbox-db and stripe-sync was typechecked by nobody — scripts/ is not a workspace, so `turbo run typecheck` never sees it. scripts/migrate-hmd.ts sat in that blind spot until it broke and was added by hand, which is the tell: a list that must be remembered will be forgotten again.
